title: Prospective in vitro an ex vivo obeservation-study of the coagulation status in patients with different pH-levels (acidosis/ alkalosis)
summary: We take bloodsamples of healthy adults and ad therapeutic concentrations of DOACs. We change the pH-level through addition of HCl and NaOH and perform point-of-care coagulation tests (e.g. ROTEM).

interventions.name:
Healthy adults:
- We collect blood samples from healthy adults.​
- These samples are transported to the laboratory and supplemented with therapeutic concentrations of direct oral anticoagulants.​
